summary: Register YouTube as a Social Core video provider through official YouTube Data API v3 semantics, with exact channel binding, Task-088 media revalidation, resumable chunk upload/probe reconciliation, bounded video status and top-level comment reads without Core changes.

impacts.evidence: One tenant-bound Account resolves one exact authenticated YouTube ChannelID; health, publication status and comment reads reject foreign channel identities before provider egress.
OAuth bytes remain Task-021 callback-scoped and video bytes are opened only from a current Task-088 released UploadID immediately before upload.
Task 048 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Task 048 consumes existing SocialPublisher, SocialPublicationStatusReader and SocialCommentReader surfaces; frozen Connector/Runtime SDK-v1 roots and Core remain unchanged.
No migration is added; YouTube channel, upload-session and video/comment identities remain provider-boundary data.
The provider receives no raw resumable Location URL. Host transport owns the official upload-session URL; provider state uses only an opaque session ID, bounded offsets and Task-021 credentials.

Only social.post.video and social.comments.read are declared. Comment writes, edit/delete, native scheduling, analytics, live streams and monetization remain undeclared where the frozen contract cannot preserve idempotency or semantics.

Task-020 remains canonical Content/Variant/Publication owner; canonical PublicationID is propagated as bounded external upload metadata and the provider returns only channel-bound video identity/status.

Resumable upload is explicit: session start, 256 KiB-aligned chunking, status probe after ambiguous chunk outcomes, resume only from provider-confirmed offset, and fail-closed session-start ambiguity.
Task 048 adds no inbound webhook surface; processing and comments are reconciled through bounded reads.

Authentication, permission, upload-limit/quota, rate-limit, missing-resource, processing/rejection and ambiguous-upload failures are normalized without raw Google responses, session URLs or credentials.
Suspend the YouTube connector account and revoke OAuth authorization to stop publication; no schema rollback is required.

Deterministic tests cover manifest parity, exact channel health, chunk alignment, status probing/resume, quota/session ambiguity, metadata limits, status/rejection mapping, account-scoped comment reads and Task-064 provider admission.
